design.source_policy: same R1.11B restricted G7 metadata-copy admission, exclude all 36 previous sources and paths; 12 each replay/gate/exam

controller.alert_identity: accepted state generation plus protected item
controller.diversity: one prioritized and one scheduled non-Cortex slot; two Cortex slots

diagnostics: accepted Cortex example exposure versus proposed exposure
per-form label recall and predicted class counts
design.exam: same fixed criteria: >=20/32 both forms, net >=4, zero old parent-correct losses, >=16 parent-correct old; fresh world seeds and source hashes; no selection on final

limits: fresh synthetic forced-choice worlds, not external independent exam; possible arithmetic or numeric semantic overlap across experiments
Cortex public metadata-copy exercises only, no raw corpus training authority
combined controller intervention (not single-factor causal proof); token work matched but wall time and replay selection differ
no production changes, promotion or exported candidate
